contentCategories.description: React/TypeScript/JavaScript, CSS, generic SVG flags, decorative curves, terminal effects and animation logic include AI-assisted code. These interface graphics are not NASA scientific products or official NASA branding.

First-person narratives, terminal logs, image descriptions and explanations include AI-assisted writing based on linked mission records. Narratives and the emergency are fictional. They are not spacecraft transcripts.

contentCategories.description: AI assisted curation and interpretation code, not the creation of NASA observations. Mission facts reference NASA sources. Horizons results are dated model calculations, weather is archival, and fallback values are labelled references or historical examples. The battery and thermal emergency are simulated interface values.
Native Web Audio oscillators synthesize fictional drone and terminal sounds through AI-assisted code. No recorded spacecraft audio or generative speech model is used. Speech synthesis was removed.

Documentary NASA records, including pre-mission photographs, composites, planning maps and surface/orbital imagery. AI assisted selection and captioning. Compression, cropping, map assembly and display filters do not turn these assets into direct observations of a machine's current condition. Individual record links and credits are retained.

Artist-made model rendered to looping video and poster, compressed and composited. The baked blue background was keyed and replaced with the shared #060910 space background through AI-assisted processing code. Illustrative and not to scale. It is not a NASA photograph.
